declarations.name: RENDER_CONTAINER_CLASS
declarations.description: The class of the `<div>` the element renders into. It is a public class name.

declarations.name: LOADED_ATTRIBUTE
declarations.description:
The attribute the element sets on itself while a table is rendered. The base stylesheet hides
the author's fallback children while it is present (Document 3 section 4, "Fallback content").

declarations.name: LAZY_ROOT_MARGIN
declarations.description:
How far outside the viewport a lazy element starts its request, as an `IntersectionObserver`
`rootMargin`. 400 pixels is about half a phone screen, enough for a cached answer to arrive and
render before a reader who scrolls at a normal pace reaches the table. The browser applies the
margin only when the element's document can reach the top-level page's origin; in a cross-origin
iframe it ignores the margin, and the request starts when the element enters the viewport.

A browser compatibility table for one BCD (`@mdn/browser-compat-data`) feature and the features
nested under it.
declarations.name: BcdCompatTable

members.name: data
members.description: A contract-conformant payload. The element renders it without a request. `null` removes the table. The element reads the payload when it is assigned, so assign a new object to show new data; a change made inside the same object is not seen.

members.name: query
members.description: The `query` attribute: the BCD dotted key to request, such as `css.properties.display`, or `null` when it is absent. The element requests it only while `data` is `null`.

members.name: endpoint
members.description: The `endpoint` attribute: the base URL of the API, or `null` for the hosted API, `https://api.browser-compat.dev`. It must be an absolute `https:` or `http:` URL with no query string, fragment, or credentials; any other value gives the error `invalid-endpoint`.

members.name: source
members.description: The `source` attribute: the `id` of a `<script type="application/json">` that holds a payload, or `null` when it is absent. The element reads the script once for each id, so changing the script's text afterwards changes nothing. A `source` that is set keeps the element out of fetch mode, even when the read fails. `data` wins over `source`.

members.name: loading
members.description: The `loading` attribute. `lazy`, the default, holds the first request back until the element nears the viewport; `eager` requests on connection. A missing or unknown value reads as `lazy`, and the property does not write the attribute back.

members.name: browsers
members.description: The `browsers` attribute: space-separated support target ids, or `null` for the default.

members.name: locale
members.description: The `locale` attribute. An unknown locale, and `null`, select English.

events.name: bcd-load
events.description: A table has rendered. The detail is `{ mode, snapshot }`.

events.name: bcd-error
events.description: No table could be rendered. The detail is `{ mode, reason, status, code }`.
